notes.title: Demo Version of our game "Black & White" is launched~
notes.notes:
The Demo version of "Black & White" will be launched on the Steam platform at 16:00pm EST+8 today.
This Demo version will open 15% of the game content, including 2 factions, 7 characters’ partial plot stories, and 6 plot levels. The game duration is expected to be 60-90 minutes for a single faction and 120-180 minutes for a double faction.
If you want to pay attention to the Demo version and subsequent versions at the first time, you can first add "Black & White" to the wish list~
Portal: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1998450/_/

notes.title: English Version Available on Friday!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Thank you for your attention and patience to Lay a Beauty to Rest. Today, we are thrilled to 
announce that English will be added to the game (include DLC) on Friday (09/02) at 1:00pm EST！There will also be a 30% discount added the same time, which will be last for two weeks!

There are some social network communities where you can share your thoughts with other fans:

notes.title: English Version Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
Greetings,
We are happily to announce that we are making the English version of the game right now. We are glad to welcome everyone worldwide to experience our wonderful game. We will continuously making announcements for our progress. 
By the way, the official English name would be set as “Lay a Beauty to Rest: The Darkness Peach Blossom Spring”.
Thanks for supporting us!

Zero Creation Game
